reason: I have run my practice on Excel and WhatsApp for ten years without paying for software, and since article clerks rotate every two to three years, spending time training them on a new system is a waste. For my two-person office, I would rather stick to my spreadsheets or at most test the free pilot before paying ₹12,990 upfront.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years, so training them on complex software is a waste of time, and manually forwarding files from 30 WhatsApp groups sounds like extra steps rather than a real shortcut.
would_change_my_mind: Proving on the free pilot that new clerks can execute filing checklists on day one with zero training, while noticeably cutting down the time I spend triaging 30 WhatsApp groups every morning.
